blocks.text: Central Abbotsford homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Central Abbotsford, September 2026. Detached houses: 70 listed at month end and 12 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 256 listed at month end and 35 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 27 over 4 months against an average of 72.8 listed, about 10.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 12 sold. condos and townhomes sold 167 over 4 months against an average of 269.2 listed, about 6.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 51 sold.
